graphics.subtitle: 2027 THEME: THE TRIUNE GOD

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: "Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee." Psalm one nineteen, verse eleven. Bible Memory is where you prove it.

graphics.anim: Red strip wipes in from left, then black bar unrolls right (8 frames); reverse to exit

shots.storyboard_caption: Two-shot, P1 quotes Psalm one nineteen, eleven

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Welcome to the SoCal Classic Fine Arts explainers. This one's for memorizers.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 3: Two-shot, P1 quotes Psalm one nineteen, eleven

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: The 2027 theme is The Triune God. You'll be given the memory material, so get it early and start now.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 3: Two-shot, P1 quotes Psalm one nineteen, eleven

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Each school can enter two students per grade in Elementary. Junior and Senior High get four each. King James Version only.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: It runs like a spelling bee. You stand in one line facing the Bible Memory Master, who goes left to right.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Round one. The Master gives a reference. You quote the verse.

graphics.title: THREE ROUNDS
graphics.subtitle: REF → VERSE · VERSE → REF · APPLICATION → BOTH
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title slides up 40 px with ease-out (12 frames), subtitle fades in 6 frames later

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Round two. The Master quotes the verse. You give the reference.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 5: Graphic: round cards

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Round three. The Master gives an application. You give the reference and the verse.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 5: Graphic: round cards

shots.camera: Stopwatch hand sweeps; ring pulses red at each tick

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: The clock starts when the Master says, "Time!" You get ten seconds for a reference, and thirty-five for a verse.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Wait until the question's finished. Need to hear it again? Say, "Please repeat the question." You get that once per question.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: A wrong reference is an error. So is any change to the verse. A word added, left out or swapped.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Mispronounce a word? That's not an error.

graphics.title: ERRORS
graphics.anim: Header bar slides in from left; unchecked items sit at 40% opacity; each item gets a red check pop and goes to full opacity at its build_at time (seconds from shot start)

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: You can stop and start over. But you have to repeat exactly what you started with.

graphics.title: ERRORS
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Two errors, and you're out. Last one standing wins.

graphics.title: ERRORS
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Learn it word for word. Know your references. Listen for "Time!"

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Questions? Email us. The address is on your screen.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: See you February twenty-fourth through the twenty-sixth at Pacific Baptist School!
